unresolved_ambiguities.fragment: filter network traffic between data-plane interfaces and management data traffic
unresolved_ambiguities.reason: While the glossary defines filtering as inspecting packets based on protocol/port, it does not resolve whether the filtering applies to the intersection of the two domains or the flow from one to the other. This requires clarification on the intended traffic flow direction.
missing_information: The requirement does not specify the directionality or the exact scope of the filtering action (e.g., ingress/egress filtering, or filtering of the entire inter-domain flow).
unsupported_interpretations: The switch filters traffic that is simultaneously traversing the data-plane interfaces AND the management data traffic.
The switch filters traffic originating from the data-plane interfaces, specifically when that traffic is intended for the management data traffic domain.
